# The scoped tier's selector's probes (TestGateSelectReach), one per line:
#
#   <changed path> | <packages whose tests it reaches, or -> [| <output line>...]
#
# The data rule reads test files' path literals as the data they read, so a
# probe named in a test file would reach that test's package by naming it.
# The probes live here, where the selector does not look.

# A Go file in no package: the module's tree walkers (TestLicenceHeaders,
# TestNoHostFacts) read every Go file, whatever go list sees.
tools/release.go | internal/guarantees
spec/conformance/gen.go | internal/guarantees
_tools/x.go | internal/guarantees

# The probes Wave 6's verification showed reached.
internal/dates/dates.go | internal/dates internal/cli internal/guarantees internal/conformance cmd/metais | code internal/dates/dates.go
cmd/metais/main.go | cmd/metais internal/guarantees internal/conformance | code cmd/metais/main.go
internal/zipfmt/testdata/x.zip | internal/zipfmt
internal/finding/testdata/x.txt | internal/finding
internal/specdata/schemas/x.json | internal/specdata
# A chapter reaches the tests that read every chapter: guarantees' and
# specdata's read spec/, and liquidspec's reads the chapters its delegated
# statements cite. examples/ is read by cli's and vectorgen's.
spec/13-authoring.md | internal/guarantees internal/liquidspec internal/specdata
examples/x/example.yaml | internal/cli internal/vectorgen
.claude/skills/verification-gate/gate-select.sh | internal/guarantees | seam .claude/skills/verification-gate/gate-select.sh

# The probes of the test economy: a package's tests reach data they name,
# not data that shares its top-level directory, and only the module's build
# inputs reach the blind packages. A package written !<package> must not be
# reached. internal/conformance's tests name "docs/guide.MARKDOWN", an entry
# of a package they write, and internal/tarw's "docs/guide/index.html", a
# tar entry; neither reads an ADR's log.
docs/adr/logs/ADR-010/x.md | !internal/conformance !internal/tarw
internal/finding/x_test.go | internal/finding internal/guarantees !internal/conformance !internal/hostfs !internal/tools/release !cmd/metais
internal/finding/testdata/y.txt | internal/finding !internal/conformance !internal/hostfs !internal/tools/release
internal/finding/x.go | internal/finding cmd/metais internal/conformance internal/guarantees internal/hostfs internal/pkgtree internal/tools/release internal/version
internal/specdata/schemas/y.json | internal/specdata cmd/metais internal/conformance internal/hostfs
docs/cli/schemas/x.json | cmd/metais internal/cli
docs/adr/ADR-004-the-template-environment.md | internal/liquid !internal/conformance

# The control, last: data no test names reaches nothing, so the reach above
# is the rules', not a selector that tests everything.
AGENTS.md | -
